title: Introducing: Copilot for Finance: Why Is This a Game Changer (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Task Switching and Time Waste Challenge

features.name: Copilot for Finance
features.description: A new product in the Microsoft 365 suite of role-based agents alongside Copilot for Sales and Copilot for Service. It empowers finance professionals to streamline operations and stay in the flow of work by bringing in data from other applications.
caveats: Currently focused on accounts receivable and collections use cases

features.name: Copilot for Finance Outlook Integration
features.description: Native integration with Outlook for collections managers to summarize email threads, surface customer information, and update data back into Business Central without switching applications.
caveats: First focus is on accounts receivables and collections

features.name: Copilot for Finance Excel Integration
features.description: Semi-integration with Excel allowing users to reconcile data sets between Business Central and Excel. Variance analysis features coming soon.
caveats: Variance analysis features are coming soon, not available now

features.name: Copilot for Finance Teams Integration
features.description: Coming feature to manage accounts receivables from within Teams using the same ERP data as the Outlook integration.
caveats: Still on the roadmap, not yet released

features.name: Copilot for Finance Extensibility
features.description: Ability to surface custom fields from Business Central entities in Copilot for Finance experiences. Users can expose custom fields from APIs and surface them in applications like Outlook using Copilot Studio for authoring.
caveats: Requires Copilot Studio for authoring custom experiences
